mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% month-over-month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE changes on positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 month-over-month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure combined with tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL changes on negative 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between GDPC1 increases and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
